comparison.objective: Prove a voltage detector before and after testing a conductor, stopping safely if proof fails.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-tool handling, button holding, ordered contact tests, and conditional safe response.
comparison.success_condition: Correct prove-test-prove sequence, or safe withdrawal after failed proof; no premature approach to the bar.
comparison.reason: This tests procedural verification and conditional safety with an instrument, not precision carriage transfer or rolling-element containment.
